text:
jordan: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy the observability changes tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Small dashboard layout tweaks, rename span->model.infer, and lower p99 latency alert from 2.2s -> 1.8s. Need an on-deploy owner + smoke checks and rollback plan. Below are proposed quick checks.

maria: I can own the deploy step. Will hand off to sam for oncall monitoring. liam can you confirm the alert delta? :eyes:

liam: I looked at the histograms. 1.8s for p99 is aggressive but OK for the canary if we keep canary at 10% traffic. I'll run the query against last 7 days and post numbers.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window for 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC. Canonical runbook: https://deploys.redwood/runbooks/obsv-rename

sam: I'll be on pager during the window. If anything spikes I can rollback. Need the exact rollback command and service tag to revert quickly.

jordan: Rollback command is in the runbook but quick copy:
```
# revert to previous image
kubectl set image deploy/inference-service inference=gcr.io/redwood/inference:prod-20260317-abcdef -n prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-service -n prod
```

maria: Smoke checks I'll run post-canary (10 min after start):
1) health: curl -sS https://api.redwood/prod/health -> 200
2) basic gen: curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/prod/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":8}' | jq '.choices[0].text' -> not empty
3) trace header present: check last trace in tracing UI for span name model.infer
4) dashboard sanity: open dash link below and confirm no red alerts

liam: Dash link: https://console.redwood/d/obsv/serve-overview?orgId=1&var-environment=prod
I've already added a panel for span rename and a histogram panel for p99. I will hold on approving the alert until I see canary metrics for 5m. If p99 > 2.0s for canary -> rollback.

maria: Noted. I'll post canary id and rollout tags in this thread when it's up. Can someone please add a quick runbook snippet to the dashboard annotation so we have a visible rollback pointer? :pray:

jordan: Done — added an annotation named "deploy-obsv-1865432100" that links to the runbook.

sam: I'll run the following watch during the canary:
```
# tail error rate and latency
kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --since=10m | grep ERROR
curl -sS https://metrics.redwood/api/query?panel=latency | jq
```
If any 5m window shows error-rate > 0.5% or p99 > 2.0s I will trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary started (10% traffic) — id canary-1865432100

maria: Canary up. running smoke checks now.

maria: health ok, gen ok, trace span name present. dashboard panels look normal. passing smoke checks :white_check_mark:

liam: Observed canary p99 = 1.65s over 5m, error-rate 0.12%. Approving threshold change for full rollout. :thumbsup:

sam: No pager alerts, monitoring looks clean. If things stay like this at +20m we can promote to full rollout.

jordan: Thanks all — promoting to full rollout in 10m. tagging final image prod-20260318-ghi789

deploy-bot: Full rollout started

maria: Full rollout finished. All checks green, no alerts for 30m. Closing out. :rocket:

sam: Confirming: no post-deploy regressions in the last 30m. Archive notes in the runbook.

jordan: Great work — thanks everyone. Will follow up with a short post-deploy doc in #eng-runtime. :tada:
